A06.title: Callback注册、撤销与排空
A06.boundary_and_ownership: Registration and revocation of statically compiled callbacks with explicit managed root lifetime.
A06.native_reuse: Existing native wake/event hooks; one optional bridge, no reflection/delegate dynamic export.
A06.csharp_surface: Opaque registration token; static UnmanagedCallersOnly trampoline uses a cookie guaranteed live by the rooted registration and two-sided retirement protocol, not by probing an arbitrary nonzero GCHandle.
implementation_steps: Implement registration state with active native invocations and queued/running managed deliveries counted separately.
Revocation closes admission then requests native quiescence; keep GCHandle/cookie until both native and managed counts retire.

Keep fixed terminal-notice bookkeeping bounded O(1). Ordinary notification validation/copy is bounded O(payload bytes) under declared byte/item limits, nonblocking and exception-contained; dispatch business handlers outside native locks. Explicit synchronous decision profiles follow D05 fail-closed and no-self-wait rules.
Handle registration failure, callback-before-return and final release through single owner-transfer rules.
error_cancellation_resources_concurrency: A pending ThreadPool item can outlive native callback return; native ack alone cannot free its cookie.
Closing dispatcher must account for accepted queued work; no unbounded callback mailbox.
specific_acceptance: Forced callback/unregister/GC/queued-delivery races, duplicate wake and rejected registration leave correct counters.
Bad UCO signature compile/runtime negative isolated; no claim method-body catch repairs it.
A06.dependency_rationale: start pins only actually consumed completed modules; acceptance adds local assembled-runtime checks where required. Reference links alone never become a global barrier.

A07.title: Task异步桥与取消状态机
A07.boundary_and_ownership: Operation state machine: completion/cancellation/result ownership/retirement are separate.
A07.native_reuse: Pinned Engine Future/executor semantics plus Core callbacks; no runtime-independent Future ABI.
A07.csharp_surface: Task-based async API; ValueTask only when lifetime-safe reuse is proven; create/register/start handshake.
implementation_steps: Create operation with callback admission closed, register managed cancellation/root, then start; already-cancelled token safely requests cancellation before or during start.
Atomically select one terminal result; request_cancel never replaces committed success/error and take_result transfers its owner once.
Publish terminal notification through bounded mailbox/sequence protocol with no lost wake; acknowledge delivery and hold result lease through DTO materialization.
DisposeAsync rejects new work, requests native cleanup, waits native quiescence and managed delivery retirement, then unregisters roots/releases handles.
Document synchronous completion and every failed create/register/start/queue/take path with current resource owner.
error_cancellation_resources_concurrency: Callback scheduling failure cannot lose an already committed terminal or free a still-live native operation.
CancellationTokenRegistration disposal/reentrancy must not deadlock under callback locks; caller timeout preserves live cleanup owners.
specific_acceptance: Port finite model and discovered lost-wake counterexample into product regression; controlled scheduler covers each state transition.
Duplicate complete/take, precancel, mapping throw, callback queued during close and final GC on both AOT OS; live owner counts return to baseline.
A07.dependency_rationale: start pins only actually consumed completed modules; acceptance adds local assembled-runtime checks where required. Reference links alone never become a global barrier.

A08.title: 可选执行器、容量与关闭
A08.boundary_and_ownership: Optional execution/admission component only when an Engine needs it; no mandatory shared Tokio process runtime.
A08.native_reuse: Tokio runtime/JoinSet/semaphore/cancellation semantics; each Engine owns its configured runtime.
A08.csharp_surface: Executor options/queue limits and lifecycle contract consumed explicitly by Engine.
implementation_steps: Implement Engine-local runtime handle or injected accepted executor profile with explicit ownership and thread counts.
Bound queued metadata, admitted work, byte reservations and retirement backlog separately; reject impossible requests immediately.
Shutdown closes admission, wakes/removes waiters, requests cancellation, drains tracked tasks and acknowledges actual worker retirement.
Expose timeout as incomplete safe cleanup and diagnostics, not force-destruction of active callbacks/buffers.
error_cancellation_resources_concurrency: Dropping a Tokio handle/Future does not prove spawn_blocking work or OS threads exited.
Cancellation paths return permits/reservations exactly once; no unbounded background retry task.
specific_acceptance: Capacity zero/full/oversize, fairness and close-with-issued-permit races; actual join ack and retained-owner counters.
Synchronous Engine package runs without constructing this component.
A08.dependency_rationale: start pins only actually consumed completed modules; acceptance adds local assembled-runtime checks where required. Reference links alone never become a global barrier.
